text:
ava_nguyen: Quick sync — Enablement asked for a stable single payload from CSMs after pilots. We should add minimal fields to CRM via automation. Thoughts?

devon_martin: +1. what's the minimal payload? link to their template?

ava_nguyen: They want: customer_id, onboarding_status, pilot_outcome, key_success_metrics, next_steps, enablement_rating(1-5), notes. Prefer CSV or webhook JSON. Example CSV:

`customer_id,onboarding_status,pilot_outcome,success_metric,enablement_rating,notes
12345,completed,won,60% adoption,4,Main contact switched to product team`

priya_shah: Can we map onboarding_status -> CRM field `onboard_status_v2` and enablement_rating -> custom number field?

rohan_patel: We can wire playbook automation to push after closing playbook run. Need to ensure idempotency: dedupe by customer_id + run_id.

ava_nguyen: Agreed. Also add health_score_delta and renewal_flag (low/medium/high) so Sales sees renewal risks.

playbook-bot: deploy job created: enablement-feedback-sync v0.3 -> staging. Logs: https://ci.redwood/integrations/enablement-feedback/1728456789

devon_martin: Can we gate this behind a dry-run toggle and only push for pilot cohorts (tag=pilot_q1_2026)?

priya_shah: yes please. also add consent check for GDPR opt-out. If consent=false skip push and add note.

rohan_patel: I'll add tests for schema mismatch and retry logic. ETA EOD tomorrow.

ava_nguyen: Great. Action items:
- rohan: add idempotency & retries
- priya: map CRM fields & consent rule
- devon: set up dry-run toggle + cohort filter
- ava: update playbook docs and notify CS staff

ava_nguyen: @everyone please react with :thumbsup: if good, or add quick objections.

priya_shah: :thumbsup:

devon_martin: :thumbsup:

rohan_patel: :thumbsup:

ava_nguyen: thanks all — will follow up in #enablement next week with rollout plan.
